Frontend head/JSON-LD verified on 8 pages (home, faq, 3 products, collection all-peptides, article tesamorelin, scientific-literature). Zero console errors on product pages. Fallback article matching by peptide name is working.

Collection page: CollectionPage with mainEntity=ItemList(numberOfItems=21, ListItems) + BreadcrumbList + Organization. /pages/faq: FAQPage(mainEntity=4) + BreadcrumbList + Organization. Article: BlogPosting with author @type=Person 'Georgi Mladenov' (fixed from iter-11) + publisher {@id:#organization} + BreadcrumbList + Organization. Home: Organization + WebSite(SearchAction) + WebPage. All JSON-LD parses cleanly; no null/undefined required fields.

storefront_regression.evidence: Home + /collections/all-peptides (21 products, coral 'Към количка' quick-add buttons aligned across grid) + /products/bpc-157-5 render with 0 pageerror/console.error events. /pages/scientific-literature renders BG title 'Научни изследвания' with body content (PubMed/PubChem/ClinicalTrials.gov links, 'Как четем данните' section, category chips).
